Built in Collaboration with [Akhil Bhardwaj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhardwaj-akhil/), [Priyal Ekande](https://www.linkedin.com/in/priyalekande/), [Natasha Gupta ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/natasha-gupta-1010/)and[ Shivam Bansal ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivamrajeshbansal/)and using  :lovable-logo-icon: ***Lovable** *as part of Course Project under supervision of [Professor Vishal Karungulam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishal-karungulam/)

The all-in-one platform connecting small brands and micro-influencers with smart discovery, fair pricing, and seamless campaign execution. We are building this as part of our Software Product Management Course, from Problem Identification, to 25 User Interviews to Feature Prioritization, to the actual Product Development and launch.

Link to the Product Development Website: [Google Sites Link](https://sites.google.com/view/swpmhyderabad-co26-serval-a/team-lion)

Link to the Actual Product: [*Chataak*](https://chataak.lovable.app/)  

### Demo

### Hypothesis

We believed the primary friction was on the SMB side: small brands waste excessive time manually searching Instagram, WhatsApp groups, and peer referrals to identify “right-fit” micro-influencers. Simultaneously, influencers, especially nano and micro, lacked a structured way to showcase credibility, set expectations on pricing, and be reliably discovered. Our initial hypothesis was that SMBs couldn’t easily find creators who could voice their narrative correctly, and influencers couldn’t present themselves professionally enough – and with the right metrics - to be found by the right brands that fuel their growth.

### Research and Validation

Through 25+ interviews across SMB founders, influencers, and managers, plus industry benchmarks, we found that:

- **D2C brands:**
- Discovery is manual (“Small businesses manually search hashtags or location tags”).
- They want authenticity (“*As a small brand, I just ask: would I engage with this creator’s content*?” / *“Do they represent what my brand stands for?*”).
- ROI tracking is weak (“*Affiliate links help, but beyond that ROI is a black box*”).
- Payment risk is high (“*I can’t afford influencers ghosting after I send free products*”).
- **Influencers:**
- Authenticity matters (“*If 5 of my 10 reels are ads, my audience will stop trusting me*”).
- Negotiations are tiring (“*Every brand negotiates; we always quote higher knowing it will get cut down*”).
- There is a mismatch in delivery expectations (*“Brands are unaware of my social media calendar and often rush delivery of content”*).
- Payments are delayed (30 - 60 days, often requiring follow-up).
- Discovery is random (via DMs, WhatsApp).
- **Agencies/managers:** confirm the chaos of informal channels and the lack of standardized pricing or contracts. We did not discover non-obvious pain points specific to this use case.
Industry data validated these anecdotes:

- Micro creators drive ~3× engagement vs. large influencers (3.9% vs 1.2%).
- 87% of creators report payment issues; 38.5% wait >30 days.
- 46% of consumers prefer relatable creators.
### Vision

Our [***MVP***](https://chataak-creator-connect.lovable.app/)*** (link:** *[***https://chataak-creator-connect.lovable.app/***](https://chataak-creator-connect.lovable.app/)***)*** will enable micro-influencers to be discoverable and credible through professionalized profiles, while allowing SMBs to efficiently explore and shortlist creators with confidence.

- **Influencer side:** streamline onboarding and profile presentation to make creators visible and trustworthy.
- **SMB side:** provide lightweight discovery/search and campaign creation tools to validate fit and reduce wasted time.
### Features

**Influencer-Side (Supply)**

1. **Influencer account creation** (must-have on-boarding)
1. **Influencer profile dashboard** (public profile + private console)
- Core Discoverability Features:
  - Social media stats with Instagram follower count, engagement rate, YouTube/TikTok handles with subscriber counts (auto-populated from signup)
  - Authenticity showcase displaying signup questions ("How would you describe your vibe?" and "What makes your content authentic?") as read-only cards
- Professional Credibility Features:
  - Content breakdown with pie chart/percentage bars showing "X% Reels, Y% Photos, Z% Stories" with editable sliders
  - Recent posts grid (3×3) with placeholder Instagram thumbnails and mock engagement numbers
  - Collaboration preferences with check-boxes for brand categories (Beauty, Fashion, Tech, Food, etc.) and collaboration types (Product review, Tutorial, etc.)
- Trust Building Features:
  - Star ratings for three categories (On-time delivery, Responsiveness, Professionalism) with 1–5 star displays and "No ratings yet" default
  - Pricing section with dropdowns for "Instagram Post: $X–Y", "Instagram Story: $X–Y", "Instagram Reel: $X–Y" with editable price ranges
- Basic Interaction Features:
  - Mock chat window with "Send Message" button opening popup interface with placeholder messages (demo purposes)
  - Availability calendar with clickable date squares (green = available, red = booked) — visual only
1. **Influencer Landing Page** (conversion + positioning with stats)
- Headline: "Where Authentic Creators Meet Perfect Brand Matches"
- Value propositions emphasizing smart matching, fair pricing, and creative freedom
- Visual elements with authenticity icons (heart, tick, handshake)
- Illustrations of diverse micro-influencers creating content
- Matching concept visuals (puzzle pieces, connecting lines)
- Stats section: "Growing Creator Community", "Quality Brand Partners", "Fair Payments Guaranteed"
**SMB-Side (Demand)**

1. **SMB brand account creation** (basic sign-up & company details)
1. **SMB Campaign brief submission** (collaboration needs: niche, budget range, deliverables)
- Campaign Title field
- Product/Service Description text area (500-character limit)
- Text area for required deliverables and mandatory elements (e.g., "1 Instagram Reel and 2 stories tagging @brand_handle")
- Content Submission Deadline date picker
- Total Campaign Budget number field (e.g., "$500")
- "Submit Campaign" button to post the brief
1. **Smart Matching** (connecting **supply** with **demand**), **Filter, Search & Results Panel**
- Niche/Category, Follower Count, and Budget filters with search button
- Dynamic grid with influencer summary cards (photo, name, stats, profile link)
### Prioritization Framework

| **Criteria** | **Definition** | **Weight** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **User Impact** | How strongly does this feature address validated pain points for influencers/SMBs? | 35% |
| **Ease of Implementation** | Technical & operational effort required to build MVP-level functionality | 25% |
| **Adoption Potential** | Likelihood that this feature drives early adoption/retention among target users | 20% |
| **Strategic Fit** | Alignment with long-term vision (professionalizing discovery + trust) | 20% |

**Scoring Table (1 = Low, 5 = High)**

|   |   |   |   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Feature** | **Impact (35%)** | **Ease**
**(25%)** | **Adoption (20%)** | **Strategic Fit (20%)** | **Weighted Score** |
| **Influencer account creation** | 5 (1.75) | 4 (1.0) | 5 (1.0) | 5 (1.0) | **4.75** |
| **Influencer profile dashboard** | 5 (1.75) | 3 (0.75) | 4 (0.8) | 5 (1.0) | **4.3** |
| **Influencer Landing Page** | 3 (1.05) | 5 (1.25) | 4 (0.8) | 3 (0.6) | **3.7** |
| **SMB brand account creation** | 3 (1.05) | 4 (1.0) | 3 (0.6) | 3 (0.6) | 3.25 |
| **SMB campaign brief submission** | 4 (1.40) | 2 (0.5) | 4 (0.8) | 4 (0.8) | 3.5 |
| **Smart Matching** | 5 (1.75) | 1 (0.25) | 4 (0.8) | 4 (0.8) | 3.6 |

Based on the above prioritization, we have currently built the following features onto the Lovable App:

1. **Influencer account creation** (Score 4.75): foundational to supply.
1. **Influencer profile dashboard** (Score 4.30): directly addresses discovery + trust.
1. **Landing Page** (Score 3.70): low effort, sets credibility and drives adoption.
